title: About Me
text:
I am a Master’s student in Applied Economics and Data Science at the University of Pennsylvania, focusing on econometrics, quantitative modeling, and applied data analysis. Before Penn, I completed my BA in Economics at the University of Cambridge.
My work sits at the intersection of economics and quantitative methods. I have built market risk frameworks in Python, developed and backtested VaR models, and worked on equity research and factor-based portfolio strategies across asset management, private equity, and quantitative research settings in the US, UK, Hong Kong, and mainland China.
